answer:
**FIX IT.** Freeze spend at $6k/mo; do not scale, do not kill unless Step 1 fails.

**Diagnosis:** $900 CAC @ $150/mo = 6 mo gross payback (7.5 mo @ 80% gross margin, GM)—healthy cash velocity (<12 mo B2B benchmark). Payback works; 2.2x LTV:CAC (<3x floor) fails b/c of ~6–7.5%/mo churn (13–17 mo lifespan).

**1. Audit math first (flips verdict to CUT/KILL if bad)**
* **True LTV & CAC:** LTV must use GM; CAC must include agency, tools, + sales/onboarding labor. If $2k is gross rev (@ 80% GM = $1.6k LTV) & loaded CAC is $1.2k+, real LTV:CAC is ≤1.3x—cut spend 50%+ immediately.
* **Brand vs non-brand:** Split branded search out. If brand CAC = $150, non-brand CAC is likely $1,400+ masked by blended avg. Cap brand spend, pause non-brand campaigns >$1k CAC.

**2. Fix ad mechanics (target ≤$650 CAC = 3x LTV:CAC)**
* **Stop starving Smart Bidding:** $6k / $900 = ~6.7 customers/mo—far below ~30 conv/mo Google AI needs to optimize. Consolidate to 1–2 campaigns; feed upstream SQLs/activated trials via Offline Conversion Tracking, or switch to Manual CPC.
* **Prune waste:** Kill Search Partners, Display, PMax, broad match. Keep high-intent exact/phrase only, add negatives weekly, kill keywords w/ >$900 spend & 0 customers.
* **Post-click CVR:** Match 1 dedicated landing page per intent cluster + tighten trial onboarding (+30% trial-to-paid CVR drops CAC to ~$690).

**3. Fix LTV & cashflow (highest leverage)**
* **Push annual plans:** 2 mo free = $1,500 upfront, clearing $900 CAC on Day 1 (+$600 cash) & locking 12 mo retention.
* **Fix churn/ARPU:** Dropping churn from 7.5% to 5%/mo—or lifting ARPU to $200/mo via tiers/add-ons—hits ~$2.7k–$3k LTV (>3x LTV:CAC) w/o touching ads.
